page.overview:
Who is Diana Giddings?

Captain Diana Giddings was a Starfleet officer in the 24th century.

In 2364, she was the commander of the . Sometime in that year, she received an order about the reassignment of personnel from Commodore Bill Marafe of Starbase 55. (, okudagram)
